verdict.rationale: Zep documents `graph.clone` as a way to create an isolated test copy of a Context Graph. That lets a user test against copied data without modifying the original production graph. However, the evidence says this is per-graph copying inside an account, not a separate sandbox environment or account-level test mode. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test environment or mode, sandbox API keys or endpoints isolated from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the testing workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Clone a shared Context Graph to create an isolated test copy of an account, project, product, or business-domain graph
